top_signals.title: Hong Kong Jails Activist Joshua Wong for 10 Years
top_signals.summary: A Hong Kong court has sentenced activist Joshua Wong to 10 years in prison under Beijing's national security law after he pleaded guilty to foreign collusion charges. (Source: Bloomberg)
